name: Rhein-Neckar Mental Breakdown 2023
information: Are you ready to showcase your lightning-fast problem-solving skills and mind-boggling memorization techniques? Join us for a thrilling day of cubing mastery as we dive into the world of Fewest Moves and Blindfolded events. Whether you're a seasoned cuber or new to the game, this competition promises excitement, challenge, and a chance to test your limits.
